title: Nezumi's First Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nezumi was raised by the yakuza to be a killer and has never known love until she meets Ao, an ordinary young man, in an arcade during a hit (Kodansha blurb via MU; ANN). They share dinners, games and a shy domestic life, but her masters will not let her go, and she must choose how far she will go to protect him and herself (Kodansha blurb). Ongoing seinen series with a 16+ rating (ANN).
life_message: Even someone raised as a weapon longs for and deserves ordinary love and a normal life, though escaping violence has a terrible cost.

content.note: ANN warning lists murder, assault, torture; reviewer calls horror 'viscerally horrific'; AniList Gore, MU Blood and Gore.
Deliberate 'tonal whiplash' between sweet romance and horror (ANN); AniList Tragedy.
Adult couple; sex used as a framing device for jokes and beats (ANN); MU Sex, Nudity, Bondage; threat of sexual assault (ANN).
Yakuza setting; not checked in sources (to verify).
Child abuse in Nezumi's upbringing (ANN); MU Tragic Past, Dark Past; emotional numbness as trauma.
Protagonist is a contract killer; framed as a trap she wants out of (blurb, ANN).

dominant: Humanity under coercion; love versus a violent upbringing; critique of yakuza power

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Yakuza codes of loyalty and punishment frame the world; story sides with Nezumi's personal worth (blurb, ANN).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Nezumi seeks freedom from the mob's control (Kodansha blurb).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Loyalty to one beloved person over the 'family' that raised her.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Contemporary secular Japan; no faith framing in sources.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Survival dominates; the dream is simple ordinary happiness (ANN).

folkways.japan: The yakuza 'family' with its rank and enforced loyalty draws on Japanese crime-fiction conventions, against which the story sets a small domestic life.

delivery.evidence: ANN reviewers describe violence presented matter-of-factly, with moral weight left to the reader and no preaching.
delivery.note: The story works through tone and situation rather than characters arguing positions.

winners_losers: Sympathy rests with Nezumi and Ao and their wish for ordinary happiness; the yakuza who raised her are the source of harm. Outcome for the couple is not yet known (ongoing).
